hooks.command: powershell -Command "$d = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $cmd = $d.tool_input.command; if ($cmd -match 'git commit|git merge') { Set-Location 'C:/Users/Admin/OneDrive/Documents/GitHub/caflow-core-ui'; $branch = git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>$null; if ($branch -and $branch -ne 'HEAD') { git push origin $branch 2>&1 | Out-Null } }" 2>/dev/null || true

hooks.statusMessage: Merging session branch and pushing to GitHub...
